fleet.claim: 1,150 established specialists + 200 registered federation specialists; per-specialist execution suites for the 200 land next

agent-bridge.crypto: ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256 via Web Crypto; each harbour signs with its own private key and verifies with the peer PUBLIC key
agent-bridge.firstCrossingGate: enforced in crossBridge(): a pair's first crossing is REFUSED without a signed, expiring, nonce-bound human approval
agent-bridge.trustSource: derived from signature-verified ledger records; never accepted as a parameter

thirdParty.semantics: CopilotKit/OpenBot docs/architecture.md — policy semantics, initiator attribution, action-boundary order
thirdParty.howUsed: clean-room reimplementation; no upstream code copied. Add a NOTICE row citing the commit.

ownAssets: ui/Beacon.tsx beacon glyph (geometry, drawn here — no icon font, no borrowed SVG)

verification.standalone: the archive ships compiled probe twins in dist-verify/ so `node dist-verify/tools/run-all-probes.mjs` reproduces every number with plain node, no TypeScript loader and no dependencies
verification.sha256Vectors: FIPS 180-4 vectors, padding boundaries at 55/56/64/119 bytes, 1,000,000-byte input, and a cross-check against node:crypto on 8 fixed + 32 random inputs
notVerified: no shared pair-trust registry (deliberate: each side keeps its own ledger)
the Evidence Pack maps clauses; it is not a certification
the 200 registered federation specialists have no per-specialist execution suites yet
key custody and rotation policy is the deployment's job; this pack provides the primitives and the registry
verification.reviewFindings: six findings from an external security review of the 19.5.4-alpha cut; all six fixed with probes (see CHANGELOG.md → Post-review hardening)
bugsFoundAndFixedDuringBuild: redactCommand read the regex offset as a capture group, so a bare sk- key survived redaction
mayAgentAct permitted agent action while a run was waiting on a person
federation specialists were tiered by domain while the docs tiered them by station; the rule is now riskForStation() and the data follows it
review: signatures were one function called twice; now ECDSA P-256 with public-key verification
review: the human-first-crossing flag was documented and never consulted; now enforced in crossBridge()
review: pair trust arrived as a caller-supplied parameter; now derived from signature-verified ledger records
review: envelope ids and nonces were derived from the request; now CSPRNG by default
review: the pack digest was a 64-bit FNV-style hash; now SHA-256
review: the archive could not reproduce its own probe run standalone; now ships compiled twins

whatThisArchiveIs: the additive 19.5.6-alpha increment only — NOT the full application; run tools/pack-release.mjs inside the repo to build a whole-app archive
